<|tool>declaration:get_weather{description:<|"|>Get the current weather for a city.<|"|>,parameters:{properties:{city:{description:<|"|>City name.<|"|>,type:<|"|>STRING<|"|>},unit:{enum:[<|"|>celsius<|"|>,<|"|>fahrenheit<|"|>],type:<|"|>STRING<|"|>}},required:[<|"|>city<|"|>],type:<|"|>OBJECT<|"|>}}<tool|><turn|>
<|turn>user
What is the weather in Paris?<turn|>

<|tool_call>call:get_weather{city:<|"|>Paris<|"|>,unit:<|"|>celsius<|"|>}<tool_call|><|tool_response>response:get_weather{value:<|"|>18 degrees and clear.<|"|>}<tool_response|>

<bos><|turn>system
<|tool>declaration:get_weather{description:<|"|>Get the current weather for a city.<|"|>,parameters:{properties:{city:{description:<|"|>City name.<|"|>,type:<|"|>STRING<|"|>},unit:{enum:[<|"|>celsius<|"|>,<|"|>fahrenheit<|"|>],type:<|"|>STRING<|"|>}},required:[<|"|>city<|"|>],type:<|"|>OBJECT<|"|>}}<tool|><turn|>

parallel_tools.description: two tool calls in one assistant message, two results
parallel_tools.output:
<bos><|turn>system
<|tool>declaration:get_weather{description:<|"|>Get the current weather for a city.<|"|>,parameters:{properties:{city:{description:<|"|>City name.<|"|>,type:<|"|>STRING<|"|>},unit:{enum:[<|"|>celsius<|"|>,<|"|>fahrenheit<|"|>],type:<|"|>STRING<|"|>}},required:[<|"|>city<|"|>],type:<|"|>OBJECT<|"|>}}<tool|><|tool>declaration:get_time{description:<|"|>Get the current time in a city.<|"|>,parameters:{properties:{city:{description:<|"|>City name.<|"|>,type:<|"|>STRING<|"|>}},required:[<|"|>city<|"|>],type:<|"|>OBJECT<|"|>}}<tool|><turn|>
<|turn>user
What is the weather in Paris?<turn|>

<|tool_call>call:get_weather{city:<|"|>Paris<|"|>}<tool_call|><|tool_call>call:get_time{city:<|"|>Paris<|"|>}<tool_call|><|tool_response>response:get_weather{value:<|"|>18 degrees and clear.<|"|>}<tool_response|><|tool_response>response:get_time{value:<|"|>09:30 local time.<|"|>}<tool_response|>
